meta.summary: Implement the approved GRACE 4 core/release contract across the Bun CLI, Artifact Grammar validation layer, query/status/navigation commands, canonical skills, packaged mirrors, marketplace metadata, README, release metadata, and tests. The implementation keeps this repository operationally GRACE 3 during product development, but the released GRACE 4 tooling is `.grace` only and has no dual-mode behavior.

task.title: Add GRACE 4 dependency, shared types, and project detection
task.description: Add `fast-xml-parser` as a runtime dependency and create shared GRACE 4 constants, types, path resolution, project detection, and migration guidance helpers. Do not implement GRACE 3 validation paths.

acceptance.criterion: `package.json` contains `fast-xml-parser` in runtime dependencies and keeps Bun as the runtime contract.

`detectGraceProjectKind` returns `grace4` when `.grace` exists, `grace3` when legacy `docs/development-plan.xml`, `docs/knowledge-graph.xml`, or `docs/verification-plan.xml` exists without `.grace`, and `none` otherwise.
`formatGrace3MigrationGuidance` tells users to use the `grace-migrate` skill and does not claim CLI migration support.
All semantic anchor regexes reject lowercase anchors and generic attribute-style identifiers.

task.title: Create fast-xml-parser adapter
task.description: Create a parser-backed XML adapter that returns normalized root nodes and parse diagnostics. This replaces regex structural parsing for GRACE 4 artifacts.

acceptance.criterion: Malformed XML returns a `xml.parse` error instead of throwing from public parser helpers.
Dynamic tags such as `M-AUTH-SESSION`, `GD-MAIN`, and `V-M-AUTH-SESSION` are preserved exactly as node tags.
CDATA content is treated as text content and is not scanned as structural GRACE anchors by parser traversal.
Root attributes are represented separately from child tags.

task.title: Implement Artifact Grammar current-state validation
task.description: Implement root tag validation, `graceVersion`, allowed metadata attributes, semantic-anchor tag discipline, context applicability, change status rules, and active/archive status location checks.

acceptance.criterion: Every standard artifact without `graceVersion` produces `artifact.missing-grace-version`.
Every artifact with unsupported `graceVersion` produces `artifact.unsupported-grace-version`.
Only `GraceChangeSpec` and `GraceChangePlan` may have a `status` root attribute.
Any semantic anchor appearing as an attribute value on a GRACE artifact produces `artifact.semantic-anchor-attribute`.
Active bundles with `applied`, `rejected`, `cancelled`, or `superseded` status produce an error.
Archived bundles with `draft` or `approved` status produce an error.
Deployment and UX context artifacts marked `not-applicable` require a non-empty reason.

task.title: Build graph and verification logical projections
task.description: Implement graph and verification index routing, document wrapper matching, ownership validation, duplicate detection, dangling reference detection, and deterministic module-to-verification coverage.

acceptance.criterion: Graph index entries route `M-*` and `DF-*` anchors to exactly one `GD-*` owner and file.
A graph document wrapper that does not match its index `GD-*` route produces an ownership mismatch error.
An anchor found in a graph document but missing from the index produces an unlisted anchor error.
Duplicate `M-*`, `DF-*`, or `V-M-*` anchors across segmented documents produce duplicate anchor errors.
Each `M-*` in the graph projection requires exactly one deterministic `V-M-*` entry.
Monolithic and segmented fixture projects with identical anchors produce equivalent projections.

task.title: Implement assertion evaluator and scope detector
task.description: Implement the approved core assertion vocabulary, DurableScope and ObservedWriteScope extraction, active change scanning, overlap warnings, and unsafe concurrent execution blockers.

acceptance.criterion: Each approved assertion kind is parsed from `GraceChangePlan` fixtures and unknown assertion tags produce diagnostics.
`MustExist` and `MustNotExist` work for semantic anchors and filesystem paths.
`MustOwn` validates `GD-*` or `VD-*` ownership from projections.
`MustLink` validates graph links and rejects dangling links.
`MustVerify` requires a `V-M-*` entry and fresh verification evidence hook support.
`MustPassCommand` runs only during explicit target verification paths and reports failed commands as assertion issues.
Overlapping approved DurableScope entries are reported as warnings and do not invalidate current state.
Overlapping ObservedWriteScope entries block parallel-safe execution checks.
